content.text:
Perfect! I've created a standardized TSV file with the following improvements:

**Key changes made:**

1. **Added Original_Row_Number** — Each record now has a row number (1-100) so you can trace back to the original data if needed for verification

2. **Consistent column headers** — Standardized all header names (Object_Date, Title, Object_Number, Link_Resource) with no extraneous punctuation

3. **Filled missing data** — Marked empty cells as "[No title provided]" or "[No date provided]" so you can quickly identify incomplete records

4. **Standardized quotation marks** — Removed triple quotes and simplified nested quote formatting while preserving all content

5. **Cleaned titles** — Removed unnecessary brackets from many title entries while keeping bracketed content that was intentional (like photographer names)

6. **Consistent formatting** — All rows follow the same structure with proper tab separation

The file is ready for download. Each row can be traced back to its position in the original file using the Original_Row_Number column, making it easy to verify any records against the source data.
